phases.objective: Consume one durable mount authorization and construct the exact canonical synthetic-only tenantStorageRuntime dependency bundle without injecting it into the live route.

e2e_journeys.entrypoint: Hostinger Storage Authorized Mount Executor Guard
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: The one-shot authorization is durably consumed and a canonical non-enumerable tenantStorageRuntime bundle becomes ready for a separately governed dependency-injection step.
steps: Validate the canonical durable authorization registry and verified SQL runtime composition.
Bind the fixed dependency manifest to the authorization mount-policy fingerprint.
Read the unconsumed authorization and prove runtime, database, schema, readback, operation, plan, generation, and expiry parity.
Consume the authorization exactly once and verify the immutable receipt.
Create the canonical durable repository facade and synthetic-only Tenant runtime.
Return a frozen mount bundle while leaving dependency injection and route mount false.
assertions: Factory creation performs no SQL connection and no Tenant runtime execution.
The raw registry, composition, and repository are not exposed.
The runtime package loader may use only the canonical synthetic adapter and durable Tenant authority components with the same database fingerprint.
The route, server, worker, provider, and Production boundaries remain unchanged.
No automatic retry is available after authorization consumption.

phases.objective: Inject the consumed bundle into the Tenant route only after live schema, runtime, migration, worker, and rollback prerequisites are separately authorized and read back.
blockers: The mount-authorization registry schema remains contract-local and unapplied.
The Tenant route still uses the fail-closed HTTP 503 default dependency.
No authorized dependency-injection or mount-readback executor exists.
Provider dispatch and live credentials remain unavailable.

phases.objective: Reconstruct the exact pending mount bundle from the durable authorization and immutable receipt after restart without a second consumption or mutation retry.

e2e_journeys.entrypoint: Hostinger Storage Authorized Mount Executor Guard
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: A restart reads the consumed authorization and receipt, proves registered generation N and consumed generation N+1, and reconstructs the same mount-bundle digest without another write.
steps: Read the current authorization and immutable consumption receipt.
Validate executor, mount attempt, operation, plan, runtime, manifest, and provenance bindings.
Require the receipt registered generation to equal the requested generation.
Require the current and consumed generation to equal requested generation plus one.
Recreate the same canonical mount bundle without invoking consume again.
assertions: A stale or advanced expected generation fails closed.
Manifest or database provenance drift fails before a new consumption.
The immutable receipt count remains one.
The reconstructed bundle digest equals the original bundle digest.
No Tenant runtime execution, provider call, dependency injection, or automatic retry occurs.
